title: Mary Magdalene lands at Marseille; Merovingian bloodline

tellings.quote: Now, Mary Magdalene, according to some traditions, did travel with Joseph of Arythea, and she disembarked at the place that is now Marseilles.

plain: According to some old traditions, Mary Magdalene, the follower of Jesus named in the Gospels, sailed with Joseph of Arimathea, the man who in the Gospels buried Jesus, and came ashore at the spot that is now Marseille, in southern France. The researcher Randall Carlson passes this on as tradition, without naming a source. The story matters to those who tell it because it is linked to the idea of a sacred bloodline running into the Merovingians, an early line of French kings.
